title: Approve a minted-token recipe
summary: Review and approve… for DJDL's applemusic recipe after a repo change: a drawer over the catalog editor with who changed it and where, the one changed field against the last approval, what the change means, who can get a token under DJDL's access policy, and Approve with passkey.
compare: The drawer opens from Review and approve… on the minted-token entry with the editor dimmed behind; there is no separate Edge mint page.
The screen is one viewport: the page behind doesn't scroll and the drawer fills the height, with its body scrolling and its foot always visible.

What changed compares every security-relevant field against the last approval, headed "Approved": changed fields first, with the old value struck in a danger tint with −, the new value bold in a success tint with +; then an Unchanged sub-head over one value per field. The eyebrow ends with who approved it last and when ("Ana Lima approved Sep 14"); the one changed row needs no count.
A widening change gets a plain warning of what it allows (a leaked token works for 12 hours instead of 1); a narrowing change has none.
The signing key is never shown, only its state (Sealed Oct 2).
The only confirm is the passkey (step-up); P0-12 holds: nothing mints until the approval is recorded.
Phone: the drawer fills the screen, the comparison stays a three-column table inside its card with values on one line, and the buttons fill the width.
The opening line names who changed the recipe and where (.pkey/schema), with a neutral link to the commit; the consequence (DJDL can't mint this token) is on the page behind, in the callout.

Who can get one lists the access policy, one fact per line: the license tiers, the device limit, the sign-in group. The other states are separate screens: anyone at all (config.approve-recipe-open-access), stale (config.approve-recipe-stale), passkey failed (config.approve-recipe-passkey-failed) and after approval (config.approve-recipe-approved).
Spacing and copy pass (2026-10-08): the screen sets no spacing of its own (kit primitives only), and each fact shows once, where it's most useful.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.
Masthead mark (lead answer 3): Catalog's read and Edit states carry the Managed config tile from 1024px (the chip hides there); the h1 stays the record step.
B17: Who can get one is license (tiers, device limits, access groups).

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fixed: the security states are drawn as four screens, the comparison reads at a glance, and the PNG shows one viewport.

findings.issue: Only the happy path was drawn: no acknowledgement for open access, no stale recipe, no failed passkey, no success.
findings.resolution: Added config.approve-recipe-open-access (warning row "Anyone who installs DJDL can get one, with no license", the acknowledgement checkbox, Approve disabled with "Tick the box above to approve"), config.approve-recipe-stale (callout at the top: the recipe changed while you were reviewing, commit 9b1e07d; the comparison reloads to 24 hours and the drawer stays open), config.approve-recipe-passkey-failed (danger strip above the foot: nothing was approved, Try again with passkey) and config.approve-recipe-approved (drawer closed, toast "Approved. DJDL can mint applemusic.token again", minting again). Approved is drawn as status text, not a pill, because the kit keeps pills for attention (ADMIN.md §5.11).

findings.issue: "1 of 6 fields" was ambiguous, unchanged values sat under one header, the last approver wasn't named, and old and new relied on strike and bold only.
findings.resolution: "1 field changed"; an Unchanged sub-head above the five unchanged rows; the column reads "Approved Sep 14 by Ana Lima"; the old value has a − and a danger tint, the new value a + and a success tint.

findings.issue: The sticky 100vh drawer stopped mid-page in the full-page PNG.
findings.resolution: The console is clipped to one viewport and the drawer fills its height, as licenses.bulk-keys does; the page behind is the fixed minted-token entry.

findings.issue: Five unchanged rows carried no decision and the change was repeated four times.
findings.resolution: "5 fields unchanged" is a closed disclosure; authorship is one line (Jonah Ortiz · Oct 6 · commit 4f2c9a1); callout "Tokens will last 12 hours"; Who-can-get-one is one sentence; editor footer sentence removed; editor banner "Lifetime changed from 1 to 12 hours in .pkey/schema. Minting is stopped until you approve."

findings.issue: Add the commit summary into the empty drawer area, or dim the backdrop less (UX2)
findings.resolution: declined: Adds content, against the terse-copy rule. Dead space in a 520px drawer is acceptable.

findings.issue: Neutral primary on dialog commit buttons (UX4)
findings.resolution: declined: Contradicts the kit's accent system. Gold for approve is deliberate.

findings.issue: Anchor the CTA row under the content (UX2)
findings.resolution: declined: Footer-pinned drawer actions are a pattern UX1 asks to keep.
